policy.originPopulation: Any official NHL appearance in the preceding three completed seasons; one row per player/origin, never per contract

First transition omitted because the one-year baseline already handles initial regression. Later measured same-role pairs weighted by game share, origin kernel and inverse eligible calendar steps. Effective peers uses total contributed pair weights; absolute nearest similarity further shrinks the blend. Survivor curve remains conditional, exits belong to the full-cohort return model.
